There are medicinal herbs that make
Pokémon healthy.{VAR BE01}

The medicinal herbs imported from
another region work very well!{VAR BE01}
But Pokémon don't seem to like them,
because they taste a little bitter.
Here it is! Your Moomoo Milk!{VAR BE01}

Oh, my!
Your Bag is full!

Oh, my!
You don't have enough money!

A dozen! That's 12 bottles.

You! Glad you came!
You want something good?
Then, show me a Pokémon Lv. 30 or more!{VAR BE01}

You, modest!
You should just want something good!

Somewhere, there's a laid-back town
where people value the year's seasons.{VAR BE01}
I heard we've imported a lot of goods
from that town!

I used to be part of Team Plasma.
I have various kinds of incense.{VAR BE01}
